name: option-list
title: Option List
description: Picker panel with option rows, search, checks, and footer actions. Rows compose List Item. Configure root width and panel match. Select composes this.

api.description: Open panel and option rows for pickers. Select composes this list for its menu. Row chrome is List Item: use that page for size, muted or accent variants, asChild hosts, and standalone rows outside a picker. Configure root width for the trigger shell; open-list width follows that mode unless OptionListContent overrides alignItemWithTrigger. Full keyboard support: arrow keys, Home and End, Enter, typeahead, and focus return to the trigger on close.

props.description: Called when the panel opens or closes.

props.name: openOnHover
props.description: Open when the pointer enters the trigger. Stay open while the pointer is over the trigger, the panel, or nested OptionListSubContent panels. Pointer leave closes after hoverCloseDelay. Click, Enter, and Space open when closed; they do not toggle closed. Escape, pointer leave, or outside dismiss closes. Nested OptionListSubmenu hover remains independent for child levels.

props.name: hoverCloseDelay
props.description: Milliseconds before closing after pointer leave when openOnHover is true. Shares the default delay used by OptionListSubmenu closeDelay.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close after choosing a row. Defaults to true in single mode, false in multiple.

props.name: width
props.description: Root width for triggers and always-visible panels (including chrome panel). hug sizes to content. fill stretches the root and trigger hosts to the parent, including OptionListTrigger render hosts such as List Item or Badge. Pass a CSS length such as 12rem for a fixed width. Select triggers inside follow the same width. Fill and fixed also default the open menu to match the trigger; hug defaults the menu to option content. Override with OptionListContent alignItemWithTrigger. Use fill for sidebar and rail rows so List Item trailing icons stay end-aligned.

props.name: itemChrome
props.description: Default List Item chrome for every OptionListItem (padding, gap, type size/family/weight/color, radius, fills, and stroke). Per-item chrome props on OptionListItem win. See List Item for the full chrome contract.

props.name: submenuAnimated
props.description: Default motion for all nested OptionListSubmenu panels. true plays open/close animations; false makes nested menus appear and disappear instantly. Overridden by OptionListSubmenu or OptionListSubContent animated.

props.name: submenuOpenDuration
props.description: Default open animation duration in milliseconds for nested submenus. Ignored when submenuAnimated is false. Overridden by OptionListSubmenu or OptionListSubContent openDuration.

props.name: submenuCloseDuration
props.description: Default close animation duration in milliseconds for nested submenus. Ignored when submenuAnimated is false. Overridden by OptionListSubmenu or OptionListSubContent closeDuration.

groups.title: OptionListTrigger
groups.description: Opens and closes the option list. Use render to compose onto List Item, Badge, or another host. When OptionList width is fill or fixed, the render host stretches to that width so List Item trailing slots stay end-aligned.

props.name: render
props.description: Host element to clone trigger behavior onto (for example List Item or Badge). Owns click, keyboard, hover open when openOnHover is set, and the anchor ref. Marks the host with data-df-option-list-trigger.

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger content (label, chevron, etc.).

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles.

groups.title: OptionListContent
groups.description: Portaled or inline panel with optional header, search, scroll, footer, and dismissOnScroll.

props.name: align
props.description: Horizontal anchor relative to the trigger. auto picks the best fit.

props.name: alignItemWithTrigger
props.description: Configure open-list width. true matches the trigger. false hugs the longest option (floored at --df-menu-min-width). Omit to follow the root width prop: hug defaults to false; fill and fixed default to true.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred placement side. Flips when there is not enough space.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between trigger and panel.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Shift along the alignment axis.

props.name: portal
props.description: Render in a portal. Set false for inline previews.

props.name: chrome
props.description: menu keeps popover fill, shadow, and radius. plain drops those so the list can sit inside a host surface. panel is a bordered card for always-visible lists.

props.name: background
props.description: Surface fill for any chrome mode. Sets --df-option-list-surface-bg. Prefer a token such as var(--card) or var(--popover).

props.name: foreground
props.description: Surface text color for any chrome mode. Sets --df-option-list-surface-fg. Header label inherits this color.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Outer surface stroke only. Sets --df-option-list-surface-border-color. Does not change header, search, or footer rules; use dividerColor for those.

props.name: borderWidth
props.description: Outer surface stroke width. Sets --df-option-list-surface-border-width. Prefer var(--border-width-hairline).

props.name: borderStyle
props.description: Outer surface stroke style. Sets --df-option-list-surface-border-style. Default solid.

props.name: dividerColor
props.description: Hairline rules on header, search, and footer. Sets --df-option-list-divider-color. Defaults to var(--border).

props.name: radius
props.description: Surface corner radius for any chrome mode. Sets --df-option-list-surface-radius. Prefer a radius token such as var(--radius-xl).

props.name: dismissOnScroll
props.description: Close when the page scrolls. Scrolling inside the list stays open. Set false to keep the panel following the trigger (it can cover sticky chrome).

props.name: header
props.description: Panel header above the options. Prefer OptionListHeader for a label, description, and edge-to-edge bottom rule. Stacks the panel like search and footer.

props.name: search
props.description: Show a search field above the options.

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder for the search field.

props.name: searchBackground
props.description: Search field fill. Prefer tokens such as var(--muted). Forwards to SearchInput background. Named separately because background themes the panel surface.

props.name: searchValue
props.description: Controlled search query.

props.name: defaultSearchValue
props.description: Uncontrolled initial search query.

props.name: onSearchChange
props.description: Called when the search query changes.

props.name: scrollable
props.description: Wrap options in the kit ScrollArea. Omit to default true when the panel has no submenu, and false when it contains a submenu.

props.name: scrollMaxHeight
props.description: Max height of the scrollable body before it scrolls. Omit for min(60vh, var(--df-menu-max-height)), or var(--df-menu-stacked-max-height) when header, search, or footer is present. When the panel opens, the selected option scrolls into the list scrollport while list order stays the same.

props.name: scrollThumbGap
props.description: Space on each side of the scrollbar thumb, in pixels. Omit to use --df-option-list-scroll-thumb-gap.

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer actions under the options (for example Reset).

props.name: className
props.description: Panel surface styles.

groups.title: OptionListItem
groups.description: Selectable List Item with value, search filter, and submenu trigger behavior. Forwards List Item presentation props (size, variant, leading, trailing, layout, and full chrome: padding, type, fills, stroke, radius). Selection, highlight, and open state stay owned by Option List. Nested submenu triggers pass ListItemSubmenuChevron (or Badge plus that chevron) through trailing. Inside OptionListSubmenu (trigger zone) the row opens the submenu on hover instead of selecting. For standalone rows and asChild links, see List Item.

props.name: value
props.description: Option value stored in selection state.

props.name: size
props.description: List Item density. Forwarded to List Item. Use sm for compact nested submenu rows.

props.name: variant
props.description: List Item fill recipe. Forwarded to List Item. accent is the picker default; muted is for quiet nav-style rows.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Not selectable row.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Presentational row. Forwarded to List Item. Not selectable and no hover chrome. Keeps resting and selected appearance.

props.name: leading
props.description: Leading slot before the label. Works with inline, stacked, and columns layouts. On stacked rows, icons align to the title line. For Avatar or other non-icon marks, set leadingFit to content. On columns rows, leading hugs text. Set aria-hidden on decorative icons. Pass an icon or other node; use "checkbox" for multi-select, "check" for a leading selected mark, or false to omit.

props.name: leadingFit
props.description: Forwarded to List Item. icon keeps the mark box. content sizes the track to Avatar and other non-icon nodes. See List Item leadingFit.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Supporting copy beside or under the label.

props.name: layout
props.description: inline places secondary beside the label; stacked places it underneath; columns is leading, main, and trailing text with the main label horizontally centered in the row and height from content. With leading on stacked rows, the icon aligns to the title line. Select mirrors stacked layout in the trigger value.

props.name: trailing
props.description: End of row slot: badge counter, nested menu chevron, measure text, or both. When set, the selected check is hidden unless indicator is forced on. Submenu triggers pass the chevron here; List Item renders the trailing slot.

props.name: indicator
props.description: Selected check in single mode. Defaults off when leading is checkbox or trailing is set; otherwise on.

props.name: children
props.description: Primary label text for the row.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional row styles.

props.name: style

props.name: activeBackground

props.name: borderWidth

props.name: borderColor

props.name: borderStyle

groups.title: OptionListSubmenu
groups.description: Hover open nested branch. Wrap a trigger OptionListItem and an OptionListSubContent. The trigger is a normal OptionListItem, so List Item size, variant, trailing chevron, and chrome props apply. Nest again inside the content for deeper levels. Motion defaults inherit from OptionList and can be overridden here.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled submenu open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Uncontrolled initial open state (useful for docs previews).

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the submenu opens or closes.

props.name: animated
props.description: true plays fade/slide open and close for this branch. false opens and closes instantly with no motion. Prefer OptionList submenuAnimated=false to turn off motion for every nested level at once.

props.name: openDuration
props.description: Open animation duration in milliseconds for this branch. Only applies when animated is true.

props.name: closeDuration
props.description: Close animation duration in milliseconds for this branch. Only applies when animated is true. Keep this shorter than openDuration for a snappy dismiss.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Milliseconds to wait after the pointer leaves the branch before starting close. Gives time to move into the child panel. Exit animation (if animated) starts after this delay.

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger OptionListItem plus OptionListSubContent (and nested submenus).

props.name: side

props.name: sideOffset

props.name: align

props.name: alignOffset

props.name: portal

props.name: animated
props.description: Per panel motion override. false makes this panel appear and disappear instantly even if parent submenus are animated.

props.name: openDuration
props.description: Per panel open duration in milliseconds. Ignored when animated is false.

props.name: closeDuration
props.description: Per panel close duration in milliseconds. Ignored when animated is false.

props.name: className
props.description: Panel surface styles.

props.name: children
props.description: Option rows and nested OptionListSubmenu branches.

groups.title: Layout and appearance
groups.description: Fixed width (width CSS length): Pass a CSS length on OptionList such as 12rem or 200px. Sets --df-option-list-width on the root. Hug menu content (alignItemWithTrigger={false}): Open menu width follows option content. Default when root width is hug, or pass false to override fill and fixed. Match trigger width (alignItemWithTrigger): Lock open menu width to the trigger. Default when root width is fill or fixed. Inline previews (portal={false}): Render the panel in place for docs and nested layouts. Trailing badge counter (trailing={<Badge>}): Number badge at the end of the row. Right padding matches checkbox rows; selected check stays hidden. Hover flyout (openOnHover): Open the root panel from a trigger on pointer enter. Keep the pointer over the trigger, panel, or nested submenu panels to stay open. Click, Enter, and Space open when closed without toggle-close. Compose OptionListTrigger onto List Item for sidebar and rail rows. Set width fill so the trigger row spans the rail and trailing icons stay end-aligned. Nested submenu row (OptionListSubmenu + SubContent): Hover the parent row to open the child panel on the right. Nest Submenu trees for three or more levels. Use trailing for Badge plus ListItemSubmenuChevron. Control motion with submenuAnimated / animated (boolean) and submenuOpenDuration / submenuCloseDuration or openDuration / closeDuration (ms). Instant nested menus (submenuAnimated={false}): Disable open/close animation for every nested level from OptionList. Equivalent per branch: OptionListSubmenu animated={false}. Custom nested speed (submenuOpenDuration / submenuCloseDuration): Set open and close durations in milliseconds on OptionList (defaults 180 / 90). Override on a single Submenu or SubContent when one branch should feel different. Item spacing (CSS): Rows use kit gap and hover/selected/disabled states via data attributes. List Item props (ListItem): OptionListItem and submenu trigger rows render List Item. size, variant, slots, and chrome props forward through. Open and selected appearance are controlled by Option List. Open the List Item page for the full contract and standalone use.

groups.title: Keyboard and accessibility
groups.description: Applies to portaled panels. Inline panels (portal={false}) keep the page focus flow unchanged. Open and focus (built-in): Opening moves focus into the panel, or the search field when one is present. Closing by keyboard or selection returns focus to the trigger. Arrow keys (ArrowUp / ArrowDown): Move the active option with wrap around the ends. Home and End jump to the first and last option. Select (Enter / Space): Enter selects the active option. Space selects when focus is on the panel; inside the search field Space types a space. Typeahead (printable keys): Jump to the first option that starts with the typed query, then to any option that contains it. The buffer clears after a short pause. Disabled while a search field is present. Submenus (ArrowRight): Opens the submenu when the active row is a submenu trigger. ARIA (listbox): The panel is a listbox with aria-activedescendant on the active option. When OptionListHeader has a label, the listbox uses aria-labelledby. The trigger exposes aria-controls to the panel while open. High contrast (forced-colors): Under forced-colors, selected and active rows use the system Highlight and HighlightText colors.
